name: Chef
description: You gain proficiency with cook's utensils if you don't already have it. During a short rest, you can cook food that restores extra hit points (1d8 + your Constitution modifier) to any creature who eats a serving, up to a number of servings equal to your proficiency bonus. You can also spend 1 minute preparing a treat that grants a small bonus (advantage on the next Con save vs. exhaustion, or a d4 that can be added to a roll) to whoever eats it, once per long rest per recipient.
